name: Compound sentence examples
description:
COMPOUND SENTENCE
⇒ I + I
⇒ Independent + Independent
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

1. I opened the book and my friend started reading.
2. He was tired but he continued his work.
3. You can stay here or you can leave now.
4. She studied hard so she passed the exam.
5. The sun set and the stars appeared.
6. I called him but he did not answer.
7. Riya cooked dinner and Aman washed the dishes.
8. We tried our best yet we failed.
9. He is poor but he is honest.
10. The bell rang and the students entered the class.
11. I wanted to go outside but it started raining.
12. She sang beautifully and everyone clapped.
13. Hurry up or you will miss the train.
14. He worked hard so he became successful.
15. I like tea but my brother likes coffee.
16. The shop was closed so we returned home.
17. He apologized yet she remained angry.
18. My father went to the market and my mother stayed home.
19. Read carefully or you will make mistakes.
20. The team played well and they won the match.
